svg.title: Devices are data
svg.desc: Each device is one row of dpi-network.yaml, an id and a kind, and just net up <id> runs that kind's steps (local: env, register; ssh: provision, deploy, env, service, register; exe-dev adds create and expose) until the device is online.

g.text: Machine facts live only in dpi-network.yaml.
Tokens never do: each device makes its own, and register copies it to the hub.
